# Sri Tulasi Agritech

> Premium hybrid maize, sunflower and paddy seeds for Indian farmers — trusted by 12,000+ farmers across six states since 2017.

Sri Tulasi Agritech is an agricultural seed company based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Founded in 2017 by Thammaneni Veere Nagi Reddy, the company produces lab-tested hybrid seeds with verified germination, purity, and disease resistance. Director: Chilakala Arjun Reddy. Operating across Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Madhya Pradesh, Haryana, Karnataka, and Uttar Pradesh.

## Products

- Hybrid Maize Seeds — 95%+ germination, drought tolerant, disease resistant, uniform kernel size.
- Hybrid Sunflower Seeds — 42%+ oil content, large flower heads, self-pollinating, wide adaptability.
- Rice Paddy Seeds — long grain, pest resistant, high milling recovery, lodging tolerant.
